sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You encircle yourself in plasma energy, before detonating it like an erupting star. But this eruption isn’t harmful, no in fact it is supportive, in the best possible way. All willing allied creatures in a 15-foot radius, centered on you becomes wreathed in your stellar plasma chakra, gaining the following benefits for the duration.

They gain a +1 Bonus to their AC.

By spending a Bonus action, on their turns, they can teleport into a space illuminated by one of your Starlight’s light, no more than 60 feet away from them.

Once per turn, melee attacks that target them, force the attacking creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazzled on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu gains the Stable keyword.
